The baseline was set 2026-08-26 FOR September, so August was never planned.
The Budget tab greys every month before this and excludes them from vs-plan,
so an unplanned month can never read as an overspend.

_savings_note: Per-month plan, not a flat average. Goal 1 is LOWER in September because
September carries ₦140,000 of one-offs the other months do not. A flat
₦249,124/month asked for money September does not have, and a plan that asks
for money you do not have gets paid out of the building fund or the buffer.
bills + one-offs + every pot = income, exactly, every month Sep-Dec.
The Budget tab proves it in THE MONTH MUST BALANCE.
account = where the money physically goes. A pot with no account is a pot
that cannot be funded on payday.

RING-FENCED, Rule 7. Never pauses, never counts toward the ₦1M or the ₦3M. ₦305,000 already in. STOPS after December — it moves into actual stocks Jan 2027, which frees ₦100,000/month from January.

Lives in the savings account he already has, called Emergency — his answer 2026-08-28.
